lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A rectilinear grid of high-luminance, circular spots arranged in vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The central visible cluster forms a 4x4 matrix of high-intensity local maxima.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Pronounced vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal carinae and circular spots to create a distinct grid-like network across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible across the flank, characterized by a high-contrast luminance gradient (light upper margin, shadowed lower margin) that defines the longitudinal structural lines.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal Echeneidae (remoras) located near the gill slits, along the ventral flank, and posterior to the pectoral fin.
